NET.35: But the high places were not eliminated; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense on the high places. He built the Upper Gate to the LORD’s temple.
NET.36: The rest of the events of Jotham’s reign, including his accomplishments, are recorded in the scroll called the Annals of the Kings of Judah.
NET.37: In those days the LORD prompted King Rezin of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah to attack Judah.
NET.38: Jotham passed away and was buried with his ancestors in the city of his ancestor David. His son Ahaz replaced him as king.
